title: Reply language
summary: Sets which language, or ordered list of languages, the agent replies in — conversation only, never code or docs.

languages.prompt: Which language(s) should replies use? An ordered, comma-separated list (e.g. "German, French") is read as a preference order. Any of the 183 ISO 639-1 languages listed in languages.json is an equally available choice; skipping this option leaves English.
